profile.headline: Lead Full Stack Engineer || Works on Java 8, Java 11, DSA, React Js, AEM, Spring 5, Spring Boot 2.0, SQL , Micro Services & Rest Api
profile.geoLocationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary: Results-driven software engineer with 14 years of experience in managing the full Software Development Life Cycle. Skilled in modernizing legacy systems, cloud migrations, and CI/CD optimization. Proven ability to architect scalable platforms and enhance system performance. Recognized for delivering complex projects on time and within budget, with strong coding, testing, and problem-solving ability.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Architected innovative platforms using Java 11, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Spring Cloud, React, Node.js, and AWS, achieving sub-second latency.
•	Modernized high-traffic e-commerce platform on NodeJS, handling 500k daily sessions, and developed reactive services using Hapi framework, scaled through Docker and Kafka.
•	Led Java transformations for insurance majors, overhauling legacy stacks, increasing productivity 4x, and cutting time-to-market by 30%.
•	Orchestrated CI/CD optimization using Terraform, Spinnaker, and Jenkins, achieving over 70% faster deployment cycles.
•	Evangelized reactive programming with Reactor Core and Akka, achieving 100K msg/sec throughput and low-latency stream processing.
•	Transformed legacy Java monoliths into cloud-native microservices with Docker and AWS Fargate, reducing infrastructure costs by 62% and improving scalability.
•	Designed microservices and event-driven architecture with Kafka to enable real-time data transmission.
•	Gained hands-on expertise with AWS technologies including ECS, DynamoDB, RDS, S3, Lambda, and CloudWatch.
•	Championed TDD principles with Jest and Cypress, achieving 85% test coverage.
•	Spearheaded adoption of Elastic Search, enabling robust search capabilities and sub-second query response times.
